title: 第17章 翠微峰第18章 这一世什么都不想失去
slug: 我气运之子反派系统什么鬼
content_zh:
十分钟后。
楚玉璃满足地打了个饱嗝。
“师尊，吃不下了，太胀了。”
墨羽看着这只几乎没有被动过的兔妖，有些无奈。
金丹期的妖兽，对楚玉璃这种炼气三层的小渣渣来说，还是太补了。
至于他自己，只是小尝了一口。
非常好吃！
但出于各方面的原因，他还是下不去口。
兔兔那么可爱，为什么要吃兔兔？
他心善，不吃可以化成人的生物。
系统应该等他吃完再提醒才好。
这时，墨羽脑海中冒出一个疑惑。
要是真能“复活吧，我的爱人”那是不是有双倍奖励？
虽然气运只有一份，唐肆的上限只有那么多。
但系统的奖励不是。
这次给了不灭金身，下次呢？
他决定把烤兔留下，给唐肆一个机会。
切下一小块肉，递给楚玉璃。
“该走了。”
楚玉璃接过肉，绝美的脸庞上露出些许疑惑。

“不带走不是浪费了吗？”
“不好吃，区区金丹妖兽而已，回去有更好的。”
楚玉璃美眸中闪着光。
金丹妖兽说不要就不要，师尊究竟是什么境界呢？
好想变得比师尊更强。
好想把师……
“该走了。”
……
三日后，天玄圣地。
山门高耸入云，通体由一种不知名的玉石砌成，在阳光的照耀下熠熠生辉，散发着淡淡的灵气。
“这……这里就是天玄圣地吗？”
楚玉璃仰望着眼前这座气势恢宏的山门，无比震撼。
墨羽微笑着点头。
“对……”
突然，一位身着青色长袍，面容威严的老者出现在面前。
content_en:
Ten minutes later.
Chu Yuli burped with satisfaction.
"Master, I can't eat anymore, it's too bloated."
Mo Yu looked helplessly at the almost untouched rabbit demon.
The monsters at the golden elixir stage are still too good for Chu Yuli, a little scumbag at the third level of Qi refining.
As for himself, he only had a small taste.
Very delicious!
But for various reasons, he still couldn't speak.
Rabbits are so cute, why should we eat them?
He is kind-hearted and refuses to eat creatures that can transform into humans.
The system should wait until he finishes eating before reminding him.
At this time, a doubt appeared in Mo Yu's mind.
If you can really "resurrect, my love", will there be double rewards?
Although there is only one amount of luck, Tang Si's upper limit is only so high.
But the system’s rewards are not.
This time I was given the Immortal Golden Body. What about next time?
He decided to keep the roast rabbit and give Tang Si a chance.
Cut off a small piece of meat and handed it to Chu Yuli.
"It's time to go."
Chu Yuli took the meat, with some doubts on her beautiful face.
"Wouldn't it be a waste not to take it away?"
"It's not delicious. It's just a golden elixir monster. There are better ones back home."
Chu Yuli's beautiful eyes were shining.
If the golden elixir monster says you don't want it, then you don't want it. What is the realm of Master?
I really want to become stronger than Master.
I really want to be a teacher...
"It's time to go."
…
Three days later, Tianxuan Holy Land.
The mountain gate is towering into the clouds, and the entire body is made of an unknown jade stone. It shines in the sunlight and exudes a faint aura.
"This...is this the Tianxuan Holy Land?"
Chu Yuli looked up at the majestic mountain gate in front of her, and was extremely shocked.
Mo Yu smiled and nodded.
"Yes..."
Suddenly, an old man wearing a green robe and a majestic face appeared in front of him.
